notes: Derived from approved 2026-06-22 discount campaign plan for the existing Graph API scheduling path.

Text announcements are Facebook Page feed posts because Instagram does not support text-only feed posts.
Photo entries are Facebook Page photo posts; if Meta /photos returns the known TOS error, schedule them as feed/text fallback posts as done on 2026-06-08.
